opennyai_summary.arguments:
The learned counsel for the petitioner  submitted that since the claim was made under Section 163-A of the MV Act while claiming self  negligence of the deceased, there is no liability  as held by the Supreme Court in the case of  Ramkhiladi and another Vs United India  Insurance Company and another1.
She  further submitted that the Tribunal erred in  awarding the amount by adopting a higher  multiplier 18 by relying on the decision of the  Supreme Court in the case of Sarla Varma  (Smt.) & Other Vs Delhi Transport  Corporation & Another2 whereas, the Tribunal  ought to have adopted the multiplier 16 as per  schedule given as the claim is under Section  163-A.
opennyai_summary.decision:
DATE ORDER OFFICE NO. NOTE  13.09.2024 Rs.4,500/- provided in the schedule to the MV  Act.
The copy of the policy of the insurance  covered liability to the paid driver.
In view thereof, interim stay as prayed for  is grant on the condition that the appellant shall  deposit 50% of the awarded amount as per the  decree within eight (08) weeks from the date of  this Order, failing which, the interim stay  granted gets vacated without any further orders.
